title: Chup Chaap Khara Puo Baqir Da
body:
Chup chaap khara puo Baqir da akhiyan wich ratt bhar aae..
<<DIVIDER>>
Aeday samnay sharam di malka jis wailay rasiyan pa kay logo nangay sir aae..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Hath rakh leya jigar tay Abid nay ratt hor bemar di wadh gae
Waala nal ker kay parda meh nosh majmeya wich jad bint e Haider aae..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Reya takda kuj kar sakeya na majboor beemar tay qaidi
Hath shimar laeen day naiza naizay di nok tay si Zainab di chadar aae..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Jinu ghar wich turna aanda nae rab janay keewain Zainab
Karbal toun turdi paidal haye sham shehar walay kinj pand okhay ker aae..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Sang maar kay zakhmi sir kitay Sajjad diyan phuphiyan day
Aehwal e raku wich takda morraan toun sain Zainab jeewain jhaldi pathar aae..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Aqdas darbar ch meh pi Kay kharay hasday log kaminay
Ohna bay deena wich kharr kay manzoor Zahra jae keewain khutbay perh aae ..
